headline: First scores in: GATE2, SC2, SC1 and the 09:50 drive all fail after costs (0 of 30 configs), but GATE2's pullback timing is real and SC1's longs lean positive; two counted reworks queued.
bullets: GATE2 (trade with the held side): 0 of 8 pass; buying the pullback beats a random bar (t 7-12), but days the hold fails cost more than held days earn. One counted rework: mid-day exit / half size.
SC2 cross-asset laggards: 0 of 12; it was the driver's momentum, not catch-up. Laggard family parked at 0 of 92 tries.
SC1 event-day gap-and-hold: 0 of 8 and underpowered (5-35 trades in 2 years); longs lean positive (best +0.355R, t 1.99). 09:50 opening drive: a coin flip before costs, closed.

Costs: lab charges more than live paper fills (0.218R vs ~0.06R per trade), so lab bars are conservative. Tight stops eat most of the cost (0.42R vs 0.09R per trade) - a minimum stop width is the next lever.
For the owner (FYI): the Setup Generator's 2-year screen does not rank live results (rank correlation -0.04 / -0.21; top screen third did worst live).
next: Tonight: CWT14SKIP -> break-even exit replay -> NH1; then plans for a minimum stop width (STOPW) and the GATE2 / SC1 reworks.
